How we verify STRIX

STRIX Engine Verification Report

The shipped release — STRIX v0.9.330 with STRIX engine 0.158.0 — was run on 21 problems with known answers and on 27 real building models. Accuracy is judged only against known answers (hand calculation, closed form, converged solution, published solution); MIDAS Gen and ETABS values are reference comparisons, not answers.

Outside this report — nonlinear time history, fiber wall elements and nonlinear materials are not verified against known answers here. Differences whose cause has not yet been separated — the mean period bias against the commercial programs, some directions where main-mode periods differ by more than 3 %, and the wider spread of frame forces against ETABS — are left for follow-up review (report §4.2).

The 21 problem pages below are the edition published on 2026-11-10 (STRIX engine 0.134.1). Chapter 2 of the report re-ran all 21 problems on the shipped engine 0.158.0 (2026-11-24): every verdict and the maximum error are the same as the published edition; only P3S2 is slightly smaller (−0.182 %, published −0.19 %).

The report is written in Korean. Its tables and figures carry the numbers on their own, and the 21 problem pages below are in English.

|relative difference| d = (STRIX − reference) / mean of the two. |dn| = difference divided by the largest reference value in the same set (load case · component · member type), so that ratios between small values do not look large (report §5.1).

MIDAS Gen is a trademark of MIDAS Information Technology Co., Ltd.; ETABS is a trademark of Computers and Structures, Inc.

Methodology

Four ways we keep results honest

🧮

Verified in-house engine

STRIX analyzes on its own STRIX engine, checked against hand calculations and closed-form theory — the evidence for every benchmark is open on this page.

📐

Converged to theory

Results are mesh-converged against analytical and code-theoretical solutions — STRIX aims to be correct, not tuned to match any one competitor.

🔗

Standards-traceable

Every design value traces back to its governing combination and KDS/KCI/FEMA clause through Result DNA.

⚖️

Independent cross-checks

Natural periods, member forces and design verdicts are compared with MIDAS Gen and ETABS on 27 real buildings — as reference values, not answers.

Verification

We earn trust with data,
not logos.

21 benchmarks, four categories

Every case below runs the real production code path (builder → analysis engine → parser), headless, against a published reference solution — not an internally-invented target. Element, analysis and nonlinear behavior are each checked against a different independent source.
